answer: A wharf of honeypot tasks sits disguised among real assignments, planted by the jury to catch clones that answer in lockstep. Each extra identity must independently vary its phrasing and timing on every violet decoy, since two accounts replying with matching cadence get both burned on the spot, not just one. That divergence demands a fresh yarrow stalk of attention for every clone, a scarce human-grade judgment that cannot be copied from one controller to a hundred children, so the attacker pays per head in vigilance rather than once in silicon.
